target_policy.scope: Selected owned-View Clone client over the published AS positive source. The extension registers one actual shared Clone callback, creates a fresh protocol ticket, and preserves the selected owned view under arbitrary finite replacement loops. This does not admit general Clone/From, the full original crate, concurrency or unwind.

scope: Selected owned-View Clone client over the complete published AS positive source. This does not admit general Clone or From, the full original crate, concurrency, or unwind.
